Definition: Jehoachaz, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jehoahaz is the name of three Israelites, and two of them were kings. In 2 Kings 10:35, Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead. The fuller story is told on the Jehoahaz, King of Judah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jehoahaz matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
